memory:
Serious landscape photographer: Canon EOS 80D + EF-S 18–135mm, reliable across five trips; plans Zion and more. Trips include Yellowstone, Yosemite, Grand Canyon. Uses Lightroom/Photoshop, many files; Adobe Creative Cloud planned professionally and Google Photos personally for convenience/storage. S

REMINDERS (from a consistency check against the session):
- Trips with the Canon EOS 80D increased from 3 to 5; the three earlier trips mentioned were Yellowstone, Yosemite, and the Grand Canyon.
- Google Photos is currently used for personal photos, not merely planned; it was chosen for convenience and storage.
- Adobe Creative Cloud is the current/planned professional editing and storage tool, with 1TB capacity; S omits the capacity and weakens its status.
- The 80D has accompanied the user on five trips and is very reliable; S broadens this to the camera/lens setup being reliable.
- The user owns a new camera strap and a new Lowepro backpack and is satisfied with the backpack.
- The user is considering the RRS TVC-34L tripod; S omits the specific model.
- The user is also considering the Lowepro ProTactic 450 AW for additional gear; this is not stated as a replacement backpack.
- The user owns or plans to buy Lee Filters, including a soft graduated ND filter with a square-filter system, and needs a replacement lens cap for the 18–135mm lens.
